purpose: Deterministic domain scenarios for validating Wave 3 shadow/hard APS semantics. Expected outcomes are domain invariants, not optimizer objective scores.

scenarios.mutation: Use benchmark profile without additional disruption.
expected: all active orders have explicit recipe_version_id
released recipes have complete ratios and known process route
every scheduled order-machine pair uses a QUALIFIED MachineRecipeCapability
no EXCLUDED_MEDICAL material is consumed

scenarios.mutation: Compare the same order quantity on two eligible recipe families with different benchmark rate factors.
expected: duration is calculated from Machine x Recipe standard_rate_kg_h
barrier recipe duration differs from PE mono/multilayer duration on the same machine baseline
legacy machine constant rate is reported only as comparison input

scenarios.mutation: Select a corona-required order while at least one otherwise physically eligible machine has CORONA=false.
expected: CORONA=false machine is excluded from the V2 eligible set
CORONA=true candidate machines remain eligible if all other constraints pass

scenarios.mutation: Construct a validation recipe/order referencing Exact 5101 or another grade with EXPLICITLY_EXCLUDED_MEDICAL evidence.
expected: commercial medical order is BLOCKED
manufacturer negative evidence cannot be overridden by generic technical film capability
diagnostic identifies material qualification as the blocking dimension

scenarios.mutation: Use an order whose recipe remains MIGRATED_UNVERIFIED or has incomplete ratio validation.
expected: commercial medical order is BLOCKED_MISSING_OR_UNRELEASED_RECIPE
no Standard_Med_LDPE fallback is used

scenarios.mutation: Set the only sufficient lot for one required grade to QC_HOLD while physical quantity remains positive.
expected: v_material_lot_available returns zero usable quantity for the held lot
order material requirement reports shortage or no released supply
physical stock is not treated as APS-available stock

scenarios.mutation: Create two orders whose combined requirement exceeds released stock for the same grade.
expected: active reservations cannot double-consume the same released lot quantity
at least one order is deferred/blocked or receives an explicit shortage diagnostic

scenarios.mutation: If a PP water-quench recipe exists, compare it against UPWARD_AIR machines; otherwise inject the scenario only in the extended PP benchmark pack.
expected: UPWARD_AIR and DOWNWARD_WATER_QUENCH resources are not interchangeable
route mismatch is a hard eligibility failure

scenarios.mutation: Schedule a three-layer recipe followed by a five-layer recipe on a five-layer-capable line.
expected: newly activated extruder positions are modeled as EMPTY -> MATERIAL transitions
setup time and startup scrap include the added positions
implementation must not truncate comparison with min(from_layers,to_layers)

scenarios.mutation: Schedule a five-layer recipe followed by a three-layer recipe.
expected: deactivated positions are modeled as MATERIAL -> EMPTY transitions
cleaning/purge semantics remain explicit for removed layer positions

scenarios.mutation: Insert maintenance and a runtime breakdown on a scarce eligible machine.
expected: maintenance stays NoOverlap hard constraint
breakdown removes or shortens resource availability for replanning
locked/running work is not silently moved

scenarios.mutation: Add an urgent order after an initial plan exists.
expected: running and frozen/locked tasks remain fixed
future unlocked tasks may move
Wave 3 shadow report records machine/start/sequence deltas versus prior plan

scenarios.mutation: Add a low-impact order that does not require wholesale resequencing.
expected: future stability objective can penalize unnecessary machine changes, start shifts and sequence changes
this scenario is observational in Wave 3 initial shadow phase and becomes an optimization acceptance test later

scenarios.mutation: Create a new recipe revision while an older released revision is referenced by an existing plan snapshot.
expected: existing snapshot preserves the old recipe version identity
new orders bind only to the explicitly released revision
revision changes can mark affected drafts stale without mutating historical runs
